renderer:
rsvg-convert rsvg-convert version 2.62.3

libraries used:
  cairo 1.18.4
  pango 1.58.2
  harfbuzz 14.5.0
  fontconfig 2.18.3
format: ICNS with directly rendered transparent PNG members

aurora.transformation: sips -s format png -z SIZE SIZE Resources/AuroraLogo.png for each size
aurora.reason: The Fedora and Arch Linux marks are not used for Aurora remixes without their projects’ permission.

reproduction: For each recorded size, render the source with rsvg-convert -w SIZE -h SIZE SOURCE; encode the seven PNGs as ICNS records icp4,icp5,icp6,ic07,ic08,ic09,ic10 using big-endian 32-bit record and file lengths. No background is added.
